entries.message: This update includes restore Jellyfin imports and document automatic Up Next sync, improve Discover recommendations, refine Discover recommendations, hydrate personal card metadata, and hide up next item after unwatch.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Restore Jellyfin watched, resume, and rating imports against current API field rules.
Document automatic Up Next provider updates when queue contents or order changes.
Add regression coverage for the Jellyfin request compatibility behavior.
Discover recommendations now use the last 12 months of watch history, aggregate across more titles, and exclude watched titles
Improve recommendation quality, poster recovery, card metadata hierarchy, and summary readability.
Restore summaries, release dates, and consistent metadata across Watchlist, Ratings, and Custom Lists cards.
Keep removed Up Next episodes hidden after their unplayed state is propagated to connected providers.
messageFragments: Fix - Restore Jellyfin imports and document automatic Up Next sync
Fix - Hide up next item after unwatch
